prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 财务指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "2022 年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "2023 年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 50px
  col 4: header "2024 年" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 51px
  col 5: header "同比" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 48px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 239px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 523px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 522px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示主要财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，并用同比和备注补充解释。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三年数值和同比；备注提供原因或背景。各行应保持清楚的视觉对应关系。","groups":["2022 年、2023 年、2024 年：同一指标的连续年度数值，适合采用相同或接近的列宽，便于横向比较。","同比与年度数值：都是用于判断变化的数字，应保持数值完整。","指标与备注：分别承担行标识和文字说明；指标需要易于定位，备注可利用行高换行。"],"keep_intact":["年度数值、百分比、正负号及百分比单位","指标名称中的数字、单位和括号尽量保持完整","年份表头尽量保持单行"],"may_wrap":["较长的备注可按中文语义自然换行，并与所属数据行对齐。","较长的指标名称可在自然位置换行；已有备注换行形成的行高可容纳指标换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [126, 71, 71, 72, 69, 113] · table 523×321px · row heights [33, 53, 53, 73, 73, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [91, 71, 71, 71, 69, 149] · table 523×260px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 53, 53, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [102, 78, 78, 78, 69, 117] · table 523×301px · row heights [33, 53, 33, 73, 73, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"三年列宽接近，数值和表头完整，横向比较清楚；指标列较宽，有助于定位行。","problems":"备注多处达到三行，拉高相应数据行；部分指标的单位仍被拆到下一行，较宽的指标列没有完全消除断行。","cause":"指标列为126px，而备注列仅113px，文字空间分配偏向指标。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"三年列等宽，年度数值和同比完整；备注较易阅读，大部分行高较紧凑，行与行之间的对应关系清楚。","problems":"指标列偏窄，多个名称和单位换行，尤其“经营现金流（亿元）”被拆得较零碎；首行备注末尾也单独落到下一行。","cause":"指标列仅91px，扣除内边距后文字空间为70px；备注列149px，宽度分配明显偏向说明。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"三年列等宽，数字区域规整；指标列比r0B宽，部分名称更容易辨认。","problems":"备注多处达到三行，使行高增加；指标名称仍有换行，因此额外的数字列宽没有带来相应的阅读收益。","cause":"三个年度列各为78px，比容纳最宽表头所需的71px更宽；备注列因此缩至117px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"均衡微调","widths":[98,71,71,71,69,142],"change":"以r0B为基础，将7px从备注移给指标，改善较长指标名称的换行，同时保留等宽年度列和较宽的备注列。"},{"name":"指标优先","widths":[105,71,71,71,69,135],"change":"进一步增加指标列宽，检查名称和单位能否形成更自然的行；备注仍有135px，适合与均衡方案比较行高和断行质量。"}]}
